name: reload-claude-md
description: Re-read the CLAUDE.md memory files in effect and re-anchor the running session to their current on-disk content, so edits made mid-session take effect without a restart. Claude Code loads CLAUDE.md at session start and has no reload command (compaction re-injects the project-root file, and summarizes the conversation to do it); this fills that gap. Reads the user, project-root, nested, and local CLAUDE.md files plus their @imports, reports what changed since the copy in context was loaded, and adopts the new version. Does not cover .claude/rules files, or an AGENTS.md that no CLAUDE.md imports or links to. Read-only and user-invoked: type /reload-claude-md [path]. It pre-approves only its own file-listing script and reads of files named CLAUDE.md or CLAUDE.local.md.
